title: Turkish-Style Zesty Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with juicy turkey, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy zesty sauce. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Roll out the flaky dough into a thin sheet.
Spread the zesty sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the sauce with the ground turkey, onion, tomato, cucumber, and lettuce.
Fold the 1-inch border over the filling to seal the wrap.
Place the wrap on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
